In A=s-z/2, B_+=s+z/2=A+z coordinates, shift the finite beta-bounded character-high trace from its original A-line to Re A=-kappa with 0<kappa<Re z. Derive the exact Cauchy-Pompeiu identity including the psi'(Im A) area connector, finite outside sides, and the crossed A=0 pole reconciled exactly with the accepted R_1 residue. Then return the shifted line plus connector to a physical mask-convolved chi_4 kernel coupled to the actual radial and symmetric top-Hilbert profiles, and prove a normalized O_epsilon(X^epsilon) estimate or a rigorous capacity/resonance obstruction.
